_comment: ADR 0140 / issue #4116 — reviewed by scripts/lib/prints-rarity.ts. `rarityFallback` maps a Scryfall rarity outside the model's four (`special`, `bonus`) onto one of `common`/`uncommon`/`rare`/`mythic`; `printOverrides` corrects one specific printId's Rarity (equivalence disagreement with a hand-written record, or a Scryfall miscategorization), and wins over both `rarityFallback` and Scryfall's own value.
_reviewNotes: 982115b2… / c9740842… (Goblin Chirurgeon b/c), fb537b5a… / 1373dea4… (Order of Leitbur b/c), 2c3070f8… / 17fe098c… (Spore Cloud b/c): Fallen Empires shipped before rarity symbols existed, and Scryfall records every FEM card as `common` regardless of its 1/2/3-per-sheet print run. The hand-written records used FEM's informal print-run scarcity tier (`uncommon`) instead of Scryfall's actual Rarity. Reviewed 2026-09-22 (issue #4116 --equivalence run): Scryfall's `common` is correct.

93dc9f02… (Ice Age, Sleight of Mind): the hand-written record says `common`, Scryfall says `uncommon`. No known print-run anomaly for this card — reviewed 2026-09-22 as a hand-written data-entry error. Scryfall's `uncommon` is correct.
